text: Education Objectives: The Objectives are to help the students to learn the basics, to lay a good foundation for international students who are going to pursue academic qualifications in China, and to successfully adept into Chinese life, to promote education, technology and cultural exchanges between China and other countries, and enhance friendship It is an alternative pathway to pursue undergraduate degrees for the students who are disadvantaged by their geographical location, family situation, education background or other circumstances. Core Subjects: 1) English Fundamentals 2) Chinese Culture and Introduction to China 3) Mathematics 4) IT Essentials (Lab and Course Work) 5) Physics/ Economics Enrollment Scale: Small classes: less than 15 students per class(including 15) Large classes: 16-30 students per class (including 16) One-to- one classes: 1-2 students per class Schedule: 16-20 classes per week(a class: 40 minutes)
